name: Serah
overview: The Scriptures identify Serah as a daughter of Asher, mentioned alongside her brothers in Genesis 46:17 and 1 Chronicles 7:30, highlighting her place within the family lineage of one of Israel's tribes. Numbers 26:46 further clarifies that Serah was also called Sarah, confirming her identity and emphasizing the importance of her mention in the genealogical records. Though brief, these references affirm her role within God's covenant community as part of the tribe of Asher.
